errors.message: A Unity Editor has /home/alireza/NeonTunnelRider/NeonTunnelRunner open and its manifest lists the Pipeline package, but no Pipeline server is running yet. If the Editor is still opening or importing assets, wait for it to finish; otherwise switch to the Unity Editor window so it loads the package. Then run unity status again. If it still doesn't come up, run unity pipeline list: an Editor in Safe Mode can't load the package until its compile errors are fixed.
